title: Heat pump not keeping up: topped off, but with which refrigerant?

sources.text: Job ticket: customer reports the heat pump runs all afternoon and the house won't get below 78. System was installed last year. Not a maintenance plan member.

sources.caption: Outdoor unit rating plate (serial and barcode redacted)

sources.text: Outdoor coil was packed with cottonwood, rinsed it out. Suction was still running low with high superheat after that, so I topped it off with 410A, about two pounds. Supply air 57, return 76.
COIL-01 Outdoor coil cleaning: $129. R410-LB Refrigerant R-410A, per pound: $95. R454B-LB Refrigerant R-454B, per pound: $110. LEAK-01 Electronic leak search: $249.
A one-year-old system shouldn't be low. I'd do a leak search before it loses more, the install is still under warranty. Customer said go ahead and quote it.
